data.key_logic: This Oracle Service Cloud CPM PHP custom procedure code is designed to handle incident creation events, applying business logic to update incident fields and send emails to CC recipients extracted from email headers. The code also constructs a customer-facing entry based on the incident's custom fields, such as request type and user request type, and formats the text with HTML styling for display on the customer portal.
